extracted.intended_audience: Heads of Executive Departments and Establishments; agency procurement and implementation officials
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and mandatory actions for federal agencies to implement the revised OMB Circular A-76 on acquiring commercial or industrial products or services, including inventories, internal procedures, reporting to OFPP, and training/coordination requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Designate senior official for implementation
rubrics_metrics.description: Designate an official at the Assistant Secretary or equivalent level to have overall responsibility for implementation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a specific requirement imposed on each agency to ensure clear senior-level accountability for implementing the Circular.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish central point of contact office
rubrics_metrics.description: Establish an office as a central point of contact to respond to all requests concerning inventories and reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The office should be the agency's central responder for inquiries about inventories and review processes created under A-76.

rubrics_metrics.name: Issue internal implementation instructions (within 90 days)
rubrics_metrics.description: Issue internal instructions for implementation of the Circular, within 90 days, providing a copy to the Office of Federal Procurement Policy (OFPP).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies must publish and submit their internal implementation instructions to OFPP within the 90-day deadline specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepare inventory of agency commercial/industrial activities and review schedule (3 years)
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepare a complete inventory of all Government commercial and industrial activities in the agency and a schedule for review of each activity within the next three years, publishing the schedule and providing a copy to OFPP within 120 days.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies must both inventory activities and create/publish a 3-year review schedule, and send the schedule to OFPP within 120 days.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepare inventory of contracts subject to A-76 and expiration/review schedule
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepare an inventory of contracts subject to Circular A-76 and a schedule showing when the contracts will expire and be reviewed, publishing the schedule and providing a copy to OFPP within 120 days.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This requires tracking contract expirations and aligning review timing; the published schedule must be delivered to OFPP within 120 days.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish administrative review procedure for determinations
rubrics_metrics.description: Establish a procedure for administrative review of determinations under Circular A-76 when objections are raised by an affected party.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies must set up an administrative appeals/review mechanism to handle objections to A-76 determinations from affected parties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Designate agency representative to Interagency Committee
rubrics_metrics.description: Please designate a representative of your agency, preferably at the working level in the office responsible for implementation, to the Interagency Committee on Implementation of Circular A-76.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The representative should attend the Committee meetings (first meeting scheduled Oct 17, 1979) and act as the agency liaison for interagency exchanges and coordination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Determine and coordinate training needs for cost-comparison procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Your representative should determine, prior to the meeting, the number and location of the personnel from your agency that require training. A major effort at this meeting will be plans for coordinating training for agency personnel in the new cost comparison procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies must assess training needs and participate in coordinated training planning for the revised cost-comparison methods required by the Circular.

rubrics_metrics.name: Objective: consistent, effective, equitable, and expedient implementation
rubrics_metrics.description: The Interagency Committee's principal objective is assistance to agencies in their efforts to achieve consistent, effective, equitable, and expedient implementation of the revised policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agency actions and coordination are intended to support these high-level implementation goals across government.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowance for security/cover exceptions (agency-specific)
rubrics_metrics.description: Agencies (e.g., CIA) may comply with the spirit of A-76 to the extent possible consistent with operational, security, and cover considerations; exceptions from strict compliance have been obtained in some instances on those bases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The memo records that security, cover, and protection of sources and methods can justify exceptions from strict compliance; agencies should document and, where appropriate, communicate such exceptions (as CIA advised OFPP).
